title: FAA UAP reports, batch 10 (237UAP00234 - 237UAP00260)
doc_notes: This document is a collection of FAA Skywatch incident reports; it contains two reports of close-approach encounters with unidentified aerial objects.

encounters.summary: General aviation aircraft reported a white, donut-shaped object approximately 15 feet in diameter, hovering or moving in the opposite direction 100 feet above their altitude.
encounters.quote: white, donut shaped approximately 15 feet in diameter

encounters.summary: General aviation aircraft reported a white, oval-shaped object at FL430 that traveled toward them, then turned away and climbed to FL470; object was detected on TCAS.
encounters.quote: white and oval in shape traveling towards them
